banner.interrupted: jojo was updated in another tab, so this one closed its database to let that update through. Nothing you change here is being saved. Reload to continue.
banner.versionBlocked: jojo could not open its database — another jojo tab is open on a different version of the app. Your records are still on disk, but this tab could not read them, so it is showing nothing rather than guessing. Close the other tabs and reload to get them back.
banner.noStorage: This browser is not letting jojo open its storage, so this tab is a blank workspace: anything already saved on this device is not being shown, and anything you type here goes when you close the tab. Private windows and some managed browsers do this. Export from Settings before you leave if you add anything worth keeping.
banner.atRisk_one: {{count}} change is on screen but not saved — export from Settings to keep it, because reloading or closing this tab will lose it.
banner.atRisk_other: {{count}} changes are on screen but not saved — export from Settings to keep them, because reloading or closing this tab will lose them.
banner.safeBefore: Everything you changed before that is on disk.
banner.corrupt: jojo has stopped saving: this browser refused a change to your records and retrying will not help. {{atRisk}} Export from Settings now — Settings → Diagnostics has the details, and reloading before you export loses whatever is only on screen.
banner.quota: This browser has no room left, so jojo has stopped saving. {{atRisk}} Free some space, then reload.
banner.otherTab: jojo has stopped saving because another tab has the database. Close the other tabs, then export from Settings if anything on screen has not been saved — reloading this tab loses it.
banner.degraded_one: {{count}} change could not be saved and jojo is still retrying. Export from Settings if you need a copy now. ({{error}})
banner.degraded_other: {{count}} changes could not be saved and jojo is still retrying. Export from Settings if you need a copy now. ({{error}})
banner.documentsBlocked: Your documents are still on this device, but another jojo tab, open on an older version of the app, is holding them. Close the other jojo tabs — this one picks them up by itself.
banner.skipped_one: {{count}} record on this device could not be read and is not being shown. Nothing has been deleted — <anchor>Diagnostics</anchor> names it, and an export from there includes everything jojo could read.
banner.skipped_other: {{count}} records on this device could not be read and are not being shown. Nothing has been deleted — <anchor>Diagnostics</anchor> names them, and an export from there includes everything jojo could read.
banner.nearlyFull: This browser is nearly out of room for jojo — about {{percent}}% of what it allows is in use. Saving stops working when it fills, so it is worth exporting from Settings and clearing space now, while your records can still be written.
